F1 and the FIA have new technical regulations this year which saw the introduction of a new power unit which is almost 50 per cent electric. metadata.content: Novak Djokovic: Former world No 1 wins China Open title without needing a match point in semi-final and final | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Novak Djokovic: Former world No 1 wins China Open title without needing a match point in semi-final and final Novak Djokovic earns his seventh career title in Beijing after Alex De Minaur is forced to retire injured after Daniil Medvedev was defaulted in their semi-final; you can watch the WTA/ATP China Open and ATP 1000 Shanghai Masters live on Sky Sports Tuesday 6 October 2026 14:50, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Alex De Minaur retired in the China Open final against Novak Djokovic after winning a brilliant opening game of the second set Former world No 1 Novak Djokovic won his seventh China Open title without needing a match point in his semi-final and final. Djokovic, who was awarded a win after his semi-final opponent Daniil Medvedev was disqualified after hitting a spectator with the ball , claimed the 102nd title of his career following the retirement of De Minaur in the final. De Minaur, who left the ​court for ⁠a medical ⁠timeout after the first set, ‌continued playing with a heavy bandage on ‌his left thigh. But he could not continue after winning ⁠the first game ​of the second ​set. Djokovic narrowly won ​the first set, ⁠with the match poised at ⁠7-6 (7-3) 0-1 when ​De Minaur retired.
